metadata.description: Standard Azure SRE Agent plugin marketplace for the read-only Azure FinOps pack

plugins.name: azure-finops
plugins.description: Read-only Azure FinOps with one consolidated, daily-refreshed dashboard. Setup requires a Managed resources, Everything or Selected subscriptions scope choice and grants missing read-only cost roles on your behalf (OBO). After a plugin update, the FinOps update skill preserves customer settings, refreshes scheduled tasks and rebuilds the existing dashboard. Includes managed-resource anomaly alerts and explicit coverage gaps for optional reporting inputs. Budget changes remain human-reviewed scripts.
